accepted_scope_caveats.label: prop:causal-bridge / ass:causal-mean-version
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The pointwise equality between potential-outcome means and the selected continuous observed-regression extension is assumed solely for optional causal interpretation, not derived from the observed-data model.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The policy-mean interpretation is claimed only conditional on consistency, exchangeability, support, and the author-imposed all-treatment causal-mean version; the statistical minimax and honest-length headlines remain observed-data claims.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 849-851, Example 1, Theorem 1, and Section 4 / Assumption 4
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives a threshold LMTP example and an identification theorem, then states that its continuous threshold intervention is not pathwise differentiable and cannot have root-n-consistent estimation in the nonparametric model; its EIF theory instead assumes piecewise smooth invertibility.

The published paper studies pointwise regression estimation at a fixed location under a degenerate random design and derives minimax rates from local regression smoothness and regularly varying design behavior.

The paper constructs bias-aware honest intervals for scalar nonparametric-regression functionals using kernel or local-polynomial estimators, including inference at a point under nonrandom design points.
The paper derives finite-sample optimal confidence intervals and sharp efficiency bounds for linear regression functionals under convex function classes, including fixed-design point evaluation.
The paper estimates a continuous-treatment dose-response curve by smoothing a doubly robust mapping and derives asymptotic properties for local-linear kernel estimation.

The published article studies effect-modifier discovery for clipped shift MTPs, represents the ratio relative to an appropriate dominating measure, notes boundary pushforward mass under clipping, and uses a classification reparameterization targeting that pushforward law; its reported inference is for its fixed-shift oracle target.
The tutorial paper exists with the stated authors, venue, and year and documents applied use of the lmtp framework for continuous and complex exposures.
